events.verdict: Adebayo (MIA) makes contact with the ball, and the ensuing body contact with Washington (DAL) is marginal.
Christie (DAL) cleanly blocks Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Christie (DAL) and Adebayo (MIA) deflect the ball away from one another as they pursue the rebound.
Christie (DAL) briefly grasps Larsson's (MIA) jersey as they separate following the pick.
Christie (DAL) was called for stepping out of bounds; there is no clear and conclusive camera angle showing that he remained in bounds.
Mitchell (MIA) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he moves after his gather.
Ware (MIA) lowers his right arm and initiates contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) is bracing for the contact from Gafford (DAL) and he releases away from the contact at the end of the drive.
Marshall (DAL) rests his hands on Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) body and he releases away to pursue the rebound.
Adebayo (MIA) releases the ball before his foot comes down out of bounds.
Christie (DAL) grazes Herro's (MIA) arm as he defends the drive.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Herro's (MIA) shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) directly contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Washington's hand after the release.
Ware (MIA) and Gafford (DAL) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Thompson (DAL) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA).
Flagg (DAL) applies his right hand to Mitchell's (MIA) body as he deflects the ball away from Mitchell with his left hand.
Herro (MIA) legally contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Martin (DAL) commits a take foul on Adebayo (MIA).
